name: HARV-03 planet sale, rollback, settlement and post-sale harvest acceptance

tests.name: Bootstrap isolated test administrator
Register ordinary planetary owner
Read Exchange liquidity setting
Fund Galactic Exchange for deterministic sale
Choose unused sector outside Federation space

data.sql: SELECT s.sector_id FROM sectors s WHERE s.sector_id>10 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM planets p WHERE p.sector_id=s.sector_id) ORDER BY s.sector_id LIMIT 1;

tests.name: Grant genesis torpedo

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET genesis=1 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='harv03_owner_qa');

tests.name: Create planet through ordinary player command
Seed planetary goods capacities for all harvestable commodities

data.sql: INSERT INTO planet_goods(planet_id,commodity,quantity,max_capacity,production_rate) VALUES(@{harv03_planet},'ORE',10,100,0),(@{harv03_planet},'ORG',0,100,0),(@{harv03_planet},'EQU',0,100,0) ON CONFLICT(planet_id,commodity) DO UPDATE SET quantity=EXCLUDED.quantity,max_capacity=100;

tests.name: Seed authoritative planetary ORE stock

data.sql: INSERT INTO entity_stock(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code,quantity,price) VALUES('planet',@{harv03_planet},'ORE',10,0) ON CONFLICT(entity_type,entity_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=10;

tests.name: Build level-one citadel required by Exchange market rules

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels(planet_id,level,treasury,owner_id) VALUES(@{harv03_planet},1,0,@harv03_owner_qa_player_id) ON CONFLICT(planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=1,owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id;

tests.name: Set planetary citadel level

data.sql: UPDATE planets SET citadel_level=1 WHERE planet_id=@{harv03_planet};

tests.name: Capture balances before rollback and successful sale

data.sql: SELECT (SELECT credits FROM players WHERE name='harv03_owner_qa'),COALESCE((SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='exchange' AND entity_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE'),0);

tests.name: Install controlled taxable-activity failure

data.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_harv03_fail_taxable_activity() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.planet_id=@{harv03_planet} THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled HARV-03 rollback'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$;

tests.name: Enable taxable-activity fault injection

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER v3_harv03_fail_taxable_activity BEFORE INSERT ON planet_economic_activity FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_harv03_fail_taxable_activity();

tests.name: Injected accounting failure rejects the Exchange sale
Failed sale rolls back stock, credits and Exchange transaction

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT quantity=10 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{harv03_planet} AND commodity_code='ORE') AND COALESCE((SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='exchange' AND entity_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE'),0)=@{harv03_exchange_before} AND (SELECT credits=@{harv03_credits_before} FROM players WHERE name='harv03_owner_qa') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM galactic_exchange_transactions WHERE planet_id=@{harv03_planet}) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Remove controlled accounting failure
Remove fault-injection function
Sell ten planetary units directly to the Exchange
Sale immediately reduces planet stock and settles Exchange inventory and player credits

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT quantity=0 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{harv03_planet} AND commodity_code='ORE') AND COALESCE((SELECT quantity FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='exchange' AND entity_id=1 AND commodity_code='ORE'),0)=@{harv03_exchange_before}+10 AND (SELECT credits>@{harv03_credits_before} FROM players WHERE name='harv03_owner_qa') AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM galactic_exchange_transactions WHERE planet_id=@{harv03_planet} AND quantity=10) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Land active ship on the confirmed planet with empty holds

data.sql: WITH landed AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM planets WHERE planet_id=@{harv03_planet}),lastplanet=@{harv03_planet} WHERE name='harv03_owner_qa' RETURNING ship_id) UPDATE ships SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM planets WHERE planet_id=@{harv03_planet}),ported=0,onplanet=TRUE,holds=100,ore=0,organics=0,equipment=0 FROM landed WHERE ships.ship_id=landed.ship_id;

tests.name: Harvest after sale returns none of the sold units
Post-sale harvest leaves stock and ship cargo empty and preserves one sale

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT quantity=0 FROM entity_stock WHERE entity_type='planet' AND entity_id=@{harv03_planet} AND commodity_code='ORE') AND (SELECT ore=0 FROM ships WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE name='harv03_owner_qa')) AND (SELECT COUNT(*)=1 FROM galactic_exchange_transactions WHERE planet_id=@{harv03_planet} AND quantity=10) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END;

tests.name: Restore Exchange liquidity setting
